title.zh: 将东米萨米斯省医院改设为区域培训医院，名称为北棉兰老区域培训医院，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Misamis Oriental Provincial Hospital into a Regional Training Hospital, to be Known as Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Misamis Oriental Provincial Hospital into a Regional Training Hospital, to be Known as Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Tỉnh Misamis Oriental thành Regional Training Hospital với tên gọi Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลจังหวัด Misamis Oriental เป็น Regional Training Hospital ในชื่อ Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Rumah Sakit Provinsi Misamis Oriental menjadi Regional Training Hospital dengan nama Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Wilayah Misamis Oriental kepada Regional Training Hospital dengan nama Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: Misamis Oriental Provincial Hospital at Cagayan de Oro City is hereby converted into a regional training hospital, to be known as Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital, with a three hundred-bed capacity.

The present officials, staff employees and laborers of Misamis Oriental Provincial Hospital shall be absorbed by Northern Mindanao Regional Training Hospital. The salaries and wages of these personnel shall be adjusted in accordance with the Wage and Position Classification Organization range for each respective scale and in accordance with other existing salary laws and regulations.

One million five hundred thirteen thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the conversion, operation and maintenance of the said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-seven. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
